name: smart-classroom-erp
description: Smart Classroom ERP System with Student and Admin panels

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend/student && npm install && cd ../admin && npm install && cd ../../backend && npm install
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:student" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.build:all: npm run build:student && npm run build:admin
